title: Elodie and the Kitchen
author: Gideon Kavanagh
blurb: Vesper Marchetti, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
